decisions: Pass explicit package, scratch, cache, configuration and security paths under the fixed newly owned ROOT. Exact getShared* branches return explicit paths without invoking default shared-directory creation.
Use --manifest-cache local; loader selects scratchDirectory. SWIFTPM_MODULECACHE_OVERRIDE points to an owned manifest module-cache directory.

Build a finite child environment rather than inheriting SWIFTPM_BUILD_DIR or other output/toolchain overrides. Preserve the parent's HOME/USER/LOGNAME values without modifying them. PWD and TMP/TMPDIR/TEMP/XDG paths are owned.
Use --enable-xctest and --disable-swift-testing via original prefixedEnableDisable options. Original SwiftTestCommand gates each framework with its actual option.

The exact --filter is applied to UnitTest.specifier via Foundation regularExpression matching. specifier is testCase + slash + name. The complete Sharing target/class and exactly three method names are anchored; looped fixture rows are not selected test identities.

Actual verbose compiler commands, original-source FileList membership, generated Swift bodies and linked product hashes are captured. Generated semantics/full final link closure require independent actual review; no current build layout or compiled declaration count is assumed.
Root/W1 thresholds are required caller inputs, never a current grant. One command, child300/outer360, jobs2, fixed256MiB observed owned-output containment. Peak and duration are unmeasured.
